title: in-TUI-tion Event Envelope
description: Versioned append-only event envelope, schema version 1. Recordings are JSON Lines: one envelope object per line, UTF-8.

version.description: Envelope schema version. Consumers reject unknown versions with a clear error.

event_id.description: Unique within a stream. Duplicate ids are ignored on append (append-only dedupe).

run_id.description: Identifies the run/session this event belongs to.

type.description: Open vocabulary. Unknown types are retained in the stream and flow through reduction untouched.

scope.description: What the event is about. All keys optional; adapters may add keys.

status.description: Optional producer-declared status hint (e.g., running, passed, failed).

payload.description: Type-specific data. May carry public-safety metadata (e.g., public_safe), which the pipeline preserves untouched.
